steps.pluginName: Desktop Mode — Fulfillment Workbench for WooCommerce

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option( 'blogname', 'OpenStation WooCommerce Workbench' );

$admin = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
if ( $admin ) {
    update_user_meta( $admin->ID, 'desktop_mode_mode', '1' );
    update_user_meta( $admin->ID, 'desktop_mode_seen_intros', array( 'activation-welcome' ) );
    if ( function_exists( 'desktop_mode_set_default_window' ) ) {
        desktop_mode_set_default_window(
            $admin->ID,
            'native:desktop-mode-fulfillment-workbench-for-woocommerce'
        );
    }
}

if ( class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) && function_exists( 'wc_create_order' ) ) {
    $catalog = array(
        array( 'OpenStation Trail Pack', 'OS-TRAIL-01', '49.00', 24 ),
        array( 'Signal Camp Mug', 'OS-MUG-02', '18.00', 40 ),
        array( 'Field Notes Bundle', 'OS-NOTES-03', '14.00', 32 ),
    );
    $product_ids = array();

    foreach ( $catalog as $entry ) {
        $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
        $product->set_name( $entry[0] );
        $product->set_sku( $entry[1] );
        $product->set_regular_price( $entry[2] );
        $product->set_manage_stock( true );
        $product->set_stock_quantity( $entry[3] );
        $product->set_status( 'publish' );
        $product_ids[] = $product->save();
    }

    $fixtures = array(
        array(
            'status' => 'processing',
            'name' => 'Riley Shopkeeper',
            'email' => 'riley@example.test',

            'city' => 'Seattle',

            'postcode' => '98102',
            'hours' => 31,

        array(

    foreach ( $fixtures as $fixture ) {
        $order = wc_create_order();
        foreach ( $fixture['items'] as $line ) {
            $order->add_product( wc_get_product( $product_ids[ $line[0] ] ), $line[1] );
        }
        $name_parts = explode( ' ', $fixture['name'], 2 );
        $order->set_address(
            array(
